title: Add support for SDL-compatible joypad GUID and `Input.get_joy_info()` on Android
body:
Related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/56181 (if this PR doesn't fix this issue, then we need to create a mapping for Xbox controllers ourselves)

This PR adds support for SDL-compatible joypad GUIDs on Android, so now we should be able to use the mappings from [SDL controller mapping database for Android controllers](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/63227bbc8ae5300319f14f8253c8158b846f355b/core/input/gamecontrollerdb.txt#L1828) that start with `0500`, while still keeping the compatibility with mappings that use the older GUID format (if a mapping with the new format can't be found, the code tries to find one with the old format).
This PR adds support for `Input.get_joy_info()` for Android as well.

See also [SDL's `Android_AddJoystick`](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/blob/ec1d66d4f693b367ff60f01eac74406b3615fbed/src/joystick/android/SDL_sysjoystick.c#L308C112-L308C123), [SDL's `SDLControllerManager`](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/blob/release-3.2.x/android-project/app/src/main/java/org/libsdl/app/SDLControllerManager.java#L347), and the way GUID was constructed in Godot's Linux joypad driver prior to the SDL3 joystick driver PR [here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/987832be460f82206fcac1467e58efbd111c5241/platform/linuxbsd/joypad_linux.cpp#L411).
